name: choir
description: Run one coding task N times in parallel, each in its own nsjail sandbox with its own provider CLI, then test every patch in a sealed jail and compare.

interface.shortDescription: N sandboxed attempts at one task, each tested in a sealed jail.
interface.longDescription: Choir runs one instruction in N throwaway nsjail sandboxes, each with its own copy of the repository and its own provider CLI. Every jail returns a patch, every patch is tested in a jail with no network, and the results are printed as a table. Choir never writes to your checkout and never picks a winner.
defaultPrompt: Run this task three ways with choir and show me the table
